Q.6 · Pong vs Frodrick Rederer · faithful mock in the current theme

Fully playable, physics and AI transcribed from Level6.ts. W/S or arrow keys to move, SPACE to serve, first to 3 wins. Frodrick is intentionally beatable: he has a 200-450ms reaction delay after the ball turns toward him, commits to a slightly wrong position each rally, and his chase speed is capped. Losing the match costs a heart and resets the score.
